cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sd_cache LANGUAGES CXX)
set(SD_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory containing upstream json.hpp")
add_executable(sd-cache main.cpp)
target_include_directories(sd-cache PRIVATE "${SD_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR}")
target_compile_features(sd-cache PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(sd-cache PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
    target_link_libraries(sd-cache PRIVATE bcrypt)
endif()
install(TARGETS sd-cache RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
